title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), version(s) Versions up to and including 6.14.20.0, contain(s) an Improper…
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions up to and including 6.14.20.0 contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the handler for a custom URL scheme. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to potentially execute commands, launch phishing attacks, and perform remote execution. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.8.
